title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final answer for v_0 in terms of omega_0 and R.

title: Equation of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly sets up the equation of motion for the stone using gravitational force.

title: Simple Harmonic Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student identifies that the motion is simple harmonic and correctly relates the period to T_1.

title: Initial Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies the initial conditions for the stone's position and velocity.

title: Trigonometric Relationships
description: Important Criteria: The student uses trigonometric relationships correctly to relate the amplitude and phase angle.

title: Final Condition Setup
description: Essential Criteria: The student correctly sets up the condition for reaching Olaflub at time T_2.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to account for the correct signs in the equations or makes mistakes in trigonometric identities.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that units are consistent throughout the solution.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student discusses limiting cases or alternative methods to arrive at the solution.
